Early Careers Coordinator
Graduate Recruitment Coordinator
Talent Development Coordinator
HR Coordinator with Early Careers experience

Based in Warwick, with a hybrid working model (typically 2 days onsite per week, with flexibility during busy periods).

Join Us Today!
If you're ready to take on a rewarding role that combines administration, event coordination, and recruitment support, we want to hear from you!

Expect a quick turnaround with a formal face-to-face interview and potentially an informal follow-up conversation.

title: Administrator - Purchasing
description:
An excellent opportunity for a Purchasing Administrator to join a global manufacturer based in Southam in their purchasing team. Reporting into the Purchasing Manager, you will be responsible for providing accurate and efficient administration support for purchasing, production and stores departments.
Benefits:
- Salary up to £28,000
- Hours of work - 8:30 - 17:00 Monday to Thursday and 8:30 - 16:00 Friday - 36.5 hours
- Private Medical Insurance after successful completion of a 6-month probationary period
- Annual Bonus - Company performance based.
- 31 Days Holiday (inclusive of Bank Holidays)
- Company sick pay scheme
- Auto-enrolment Pension

Duties and Responsibilities:
Working closely with the Purchasing Manager to ensure that all the below are achieved and maintained so that customer delivery requirements are met and on time.
- Raise purchase orders for both stock and non-stock items.
- Liaise with suppliers to negotiate the best prices, dependent on delivery required, ensuring the suppliers are quoting like for like products.
- Maintain accurate purchase price and supplier details on the system.
- Review purchase order acknowledgements from suppliers and raise and resolve any discrepancies.
- Resolve stock queries with suppliers and our stores department i.e. Negative stock levels, Incorrect locations, stock levels etc.
- Maintain the Purchase order spreadsheet for current suppliers to ensure all goods arrive to schedule.
- Create supplier accounts on the Sage system, making sure all relevant detail is added.
- Create part numbers and amend the part descriptions on Sage.
- Ensure stock items are updated with the correct buying price.
- Produce and action stock adjustments.
- Update bill of materials (BOMs) from update from production.
- Process internal works instructions, including swap abouts.
- Raise returns to suppliers.
- Chase purchase returns and maintain purchase returns spread sheet, keeping the Senior Buyer aware of any issues that arise.
- Liaise with production and sales regarding reasons for return, advising the supplier when required and keep the relevant departments updated regarding delivery dates for repaired items.
- Answer the phone calls efficiently, redirecting calls, assisting callers or taking messages.
- Provide cover for other members of office staff during absence, holidays and when requested.

Skills & Experience Required:
- Previous experience in a similar role
- Excellent customer service, providing a friendly and courteous front of house image.
- Excellent communication and people skills
- Effective interpretation of instructions
- Proficient typing and data processing
- Computer literacy, capable of using Sage Accounts, Internet, email and the Microsoft Office suite
- Adaptable, flexible and capable of managing changing priorities and tasks.
- Conscientious and diligent with a keen eye for detail
- Self-motivated and capable of using initiative.
- High importance to attention to detail is a key point.

Please apply today!

title: Help Desk Operator
description:
Helpdesk Operator

Warwick - Onsite

£29,000 - £32,000

VIQU are partnering with a leading organisation to recruit a Helpdesk Operator to provide first-line IT support across the business. This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced Service Desk professional to broaden their technical knowledge while supporting users across multiple UK locations. The successful candidate will work across a varied Microsoft environment, including Intune, Entra ID, Microsoft 365 and Windows 11, alongside hardware, mobile devices, printers and business systems. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with a strong customer-focused approach who enjoys troubleshooting and wants to continue developing their IT career within a busy support environment.

Key Responsibilities of the Helpdesk Operator:
- Act as the first point of contact for IT support requests, providing effective first-line technical assistance
- Log, prioritise, investigate and resolve service desk tickets within agreed processes
- Troubleshoot Windows 11, Microsoft 365, desktop hardware, printers, mobile devices and business systems
- Support and administer user devices through Microsoft Intune
- Assist with user accounts, access and devices across Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory
- Provide remote and face-to-face technical support to users across Warwick and wider UK locations
- Set up, configure and maintain IT equipment, applications and user devices
- Support SharePoint and other Microsoft business applications
- Create and maintain user guides, training materials and IT documentation
- Work closely with infrastructure teams and external suppliers to investigate and resolve technical issues

Key Experience Required of the Helpdesk Operator:
- Proven experience working within a Service Desk, Helpdesk or first-line IT support environment
- Strong hands-on experience supporting Microsoft 365, Windows 11 and desktop applications
- Practical experience with Microsoft Intune and Entra ID
- Strong troubleshooting experience, particularly across hardware, software and printer-related issues
- Experience with SharePoint would be highly desirable
- Good understanding of Active Directory and user account administration
- Strong customer service and communication skills, with the ability to support users at different technical levels
- Ability to manage and prioritise multiple support tickets and tasks effectively
- A proactive approach to problem-solving with a genuine desire to develop technical
